title: 01 · Proceso
description: Operación en tiempo real: variables, tendencias, estado, mando y producción.

list.name: plc
list.label: PLC
list.definition: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sensor_readings" WITH KEY = "plc"
list.query: SHOW TAG VALUES FROM "sensor_readings" WITH KEY = "plc"

target.rawSql: SELECT ts_active AS time, COALESCE(ts_resolved, NOW()) AS timeend, variable || ': ' || COALESCE(message, '') AS text, severity::text AS tags FROM alarms WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL' AND $__timeFilter(ts_active)

SELECT ts_active AS time, COALESCE(ts_resolved, NOW()) AS timeend, variable || ': ' || COALESCE(message, '') AS text, severity::text AS tags FROM alarms WHERE severity = 'HIGH' AND $__timeFilter(ts_active)

SELECT ts_active AS time, COALESCE(ts_resolved, NOW()) AS timeend, variable || ': ' || COALESCE(message, '') AS text, severity::text AS tags FROM alarms WHERE severity = 'WARNING' AND $__timeFilter(ts_active)

panels.title: Nivel del depósito
panels.description: Nivel actual. Bandas: < 100 L nivel bajo, > 900 L nivel alto (umbrales del motor de alarmas).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'nivel_x10' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Velocidad de bomba
panels.description: Velocidad del variador. > 95 % genera aviso de velocidad alta.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'velocidad' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Transmisor de nivel
panels.description: Lazo 4–20 mA del sensor de nivel. Fuera de 3,8–20,5 mA indica fallo del lazo (NAMUR NE43).

targets.query: SELECT last("value") / 100.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'nivel_ma' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Caudal de entrada
panels.description: Caudal de entrada con su tendencia en el rango.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'caudal_ent' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Caudal de salida
panels.description: Caudal de salida (producción) con su tendencia en el rango.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'caudal_sal' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Nivel del depósito
panels.description: Nivel con las líneas de alarma de nivel bajo (100 L) y alto (900 L).

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'nivel_x10' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Caudales y balance
panels.description: Entrada y salida (líneas) y balance neto entrada − salida (barras, eje derecho).

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'caudal_ent' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT mean("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'caudal_sal' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Velocidad y consigna
panels.description: Velocidad del variador frente a la consigna manual (solo aplica en modo manual).

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'velocidad' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)
SELECT last("value") FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'consigna_manual' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Señal del transmisor
panels.description: Lazo 4–20 mA con las zonas de fallo NAMUR (< 3,8 mA y > 20,5 mA) sombreadas.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") / 100.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'nivel_ma' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(none)

panels.title: Registro de estado (bit a bit)
panels.description: Decodificación del registro de estado. Encendido = color; apagado = gris. Los bits 6–9 no están documentados en el contrato y se muestran para no ocultar información.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 2) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 4) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 8) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 16) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 32) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 64) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 128) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 256) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 512) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Mando observado
panels.description: Registros de mando escritos desde FUXA (OT). IT solo los observa: nunca escribe en el PLC.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'modo_manual' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("value") FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'mando_marcha' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("value") FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'mando_valvula' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter
SELECT last("value") FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'consigna_manual' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Cronología de estado
panels.description: Qué estuvo activo y cuándo: bomba, fallos, seta, modo y válvula.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 4) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 8) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 2) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT last("value") % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'modo_manual' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)
SELECT FLOOR(last("value") / 512) % 2 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(previous)

panels.title: Producción en el rango
panels.description: Volumen bombeado: integral del caudal de salida.

targets.query: SELECT integral("value") / 10.0 / 60.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'caudal_sal' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Variación de nivel
panels.description: Nivel final − nivel inicial del rango.

targets.query: SELECT last("value") / 10.0 - first("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'nivel_x10' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Rendimiento
panels.description: Caudal medio de salida frente al fondo de escala (150 l/min).

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") / 10.0 / 150.0 * 100.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'caudal_sal' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter

panels.title: Tiempo en marcha
panels.description: Porcentaje del rango con el contactor de bomba cerrado.

targets.query: SELECT mean(b) * 100.0 FROM (SELECT "value" % 2 AS b FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'estado' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter)

panels.title: Producción acumulada
panels.description: Volumen acumulado a lo largo del rango (suma de caudales medios por minuto).

targets.query: SELECT CUMULATIVE_SUM(mean("value")) / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'caudal_sal' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1m) fill(0)

panels.title: Nivel: contexto de 24 h
panels.description: Ciclos de llenado y vaciado de las últimas 24 h (media cada 5 min), independiente del rango.

targets.query: SELECT mean("value") / 10.0 FROM "sensor_readings" WHERE ("variable" = 'nivel_x10' AND "plc" =~ /^$plc$/) AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time(5m) fill(none)
